args.sql:
WITH SiteAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temperature,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM 
        scanenvironment AS se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.site_code,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (sa.avg_temperature + sa.avg_humidity + sa.avg_illumination) / 3) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM 
        SiteAverages AS sa
),
EnvironmentalConditions AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.site_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN -5 AND 5 THEN 'Cold' 
            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN 6 AND 15 THEN 'Cool' 
            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN 16 AND 25 THEN 'Mild' 
            ELSE 'Hot' 
        END AS temperature_category,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_humidity < 30 THEN 'Dry' 
            WHEN ss.avg_humidity BETWEEN 30 AND 60 THEN 'Moderate' 
            ELSE 'Humid' 
        END AS humidity_category,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_illumination < 10000 THEN 'Low Light' 
            WHEN ss.avg_illumination BETWEEN 10000 AND 50000 THEN 'Moderate Light' 
            ELSE 'High Light' 
        END AS illumination_category
    FROM 
        SiteAverages AS ss
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile,
    ec.temperature_category,
    ec.humidity_category,
    ec.illumination_category
FROM 
    sites AS s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages AS sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    SiteSuitability AS ss ON sa.site_code = ss.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    EnvironmentalConditions AS ec ON sa.site_code = ec.site_code
ORDER BY 
    s.zonelabel;

WITH SiteAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temperature,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM 
        scanenvironment AS se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.site_code,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (sa.avg_temperature + sa.avg_humidity + sa.avg_illumination) / 3) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM 
        SiteAverages AS sa
),
EnvironmentalConditions AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.site_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN -5 AND 5 THEN 'Cold' 
            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN 6 AND 15 THEN 'Cool' 
            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN 16 AND 25 THEN 'Mild' 
            ELSE 'Hot' 
        END AS temperature_category,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_humidity < 30 THEN 'Dry' 
            WHEN ss.avg_humidity BETWEEN 30 AND 60 THEN 'Moderate' 
            ELSE 'Humid' 
        END AS humidity_category,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_illumination < 10000 THEN 'Low Light' 
            WHEN ss.avg_illumination BETWEEN 10000 AND 50000 THEN 'Moderate Light' 
            ELSE 'High Light' 
        END AS illumination_category
    FROM 
        SiteAverages AS ss
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile,
    ec.temperature_category,
    ec.humidity_category,
    ec.illumination_category
FROM 
    sites AS s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages AS sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    SiteSuitability AS ss ON sa.site_code = ss.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    EnvironmentalConditions AS ec ON sa.site_code = ec.site_code
ORDER BY 
    s.zonelabel;
